Energy Efficient Skylight Options

, like other roof windows, come in several forms and types, so compare the options before you install skylights. Fixed skylights only admit light; the energy efficient choice can be a fixed, vented, or solar-powered model, and tubular skylights, or sun tunnels, bring natural light into a hall where a full unit will not fit. Low-emissivity (low-E) coatings add UV protection and efficiency, double-pane or triple-pane glass improves insulation, ENERGY STAR-rated skylights are available today, and energy-efficient skylights can cut electricity use for daytime light and energy costs; a vented unit you can open adds ventilation. Skylights older than 10 years may not be energy efficient, so a newer model can offer better value along with the benefits of natural light and a view of the outdoors.

c.v: How much does it cost to repair a skylight?

runs.v: A reseal runs $75–$250 and a flashing repair $150–$500, per Angi and Modernize. Other published New Jersey figures put reflashing at $300–$600 against $1,500–$2,500 for replacement, a basic new skylight installation at $800–$2,700, and a sun tunnel at $500–$1,000, so reflashing a sound unit saves hundreds and is often the better value. A same size replacement reuses the opening, and contractors should provide detailed written estimates that separate labor and materials; ask for that quote in writing.

c.v: Does homeowners insurance cover skylight leaks?

runs.v: Usually only when a covered event, such as a falling limb or wind, damages the skylight suddenly; worn flashing and age are generally treated as maintenance. The company photographs damage for insurance claims.

c.v: Can you install skylights without replacing the roof?

runs.v: Yes: a roofer can install skylights or perform a replacement on a sound roof by weaving new flashing into the existing covering. Replacing skylights during roof work prevents future leaks, though, so experts recommend replacing an older skylight along with the roof, and it usually pays to replace skylights older than about 15 years; a re-roof is the best opportunity.
